extracted.name: Apple and Zucchini Salad
extracted.description: This apple zucchini salad with green bell pepper and red onion is tossed in a basil vinaigrette for a quick and scrmptious salad for summer picnics.
instruction_lines: Combine zucchini, apples, bell pepper, and onion in a serving bowl.
Whisk together oil, vinegar, sugar, basil, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl until well combined; drizzle over zucchini-apple mixture. Toss to coat.
